title: Ender Tank
subtitle: LV, 8 FE/t, 16 shared buckets
text:
Every Ender Tank on the same code shares one tank of 16 buckets of one fluid. Fluid pipes connect on any side, private or not.

Put a bucket of fluid in the top slot to pour it in, or an empty bucket to fill it; the result comes out below.

It uses 8 FE/t and holds 20k FE, and stops sharing without power. The code survives breaking and taking it apart, and the fluid stays on the code.
caption: Two tanks, one fluid
